settings.title: Settings
settings.hudSubtitle: Floating indicator, full-screen game behavior, and in-game shortcuts.
settings.appearanceDesc: Customize how limits are displayed during use.
settings.showHudDesc: Keeps a compact floating timer visible at the top of limited applications. When disabled, you can still peek at your remaining time using the keyboard shortcut.
settings.showHudInFullscreenDesc: Keeps the floating timer visible continuously over full-screen games and 3D applications. To preserve native display refresh rates and driver frame limiters, leave disabled and use the Peek Shortcut instead.
settings.hudPeekShortcutDesc: Global keyboard shortcut to temporarily reveal remaining screen time for 4 seconds on demand. Works across all applications and games, even when the continuous timer is disabled.
settings.alertsSubtitle: Studio-grade audio chimes and milestone notifications as limits approach.
settings.milestonesDesc: Tether automatically plays a soothing harmonic chime and surfaces a 4-second timer peek when remaining screen time reaches key thresholds: 15m, 10m, 5m, and 1m, and when a limit is reached.
settings.chimeDesignNote: Gentle, non-intrusive harmonic chime designed to never startle or clash with game audio.
settings.alertVolumeDesc: Adjust the volume level of milestone warnings and overlay chimes.
settings.pinSet: A PIN is currently required to change limits.
settings.pinNotSet: No PIN is set. Limits can be removed freely.
settings.advancedDesc: Deep configuration of how limits and tracking operate.
settings.cooldownDesc: How long a loosened limit waits before it takes effect. Tightening, pausing and removing a limit apply right away.
settings.dayResetDesc: When does daily screen time reset to zero?
settings.idleThresholdDesc: How quickly does time stop tracking when you step away?
settings.strictModeDesc: Disables the emergency +15 minutes override entirely.
settings.networkDesc: System-wide domain filtering and upstream DNS configuration.
settings.familyDnsDesc: Filter adult and malicious domains system-wide using Cloudflare Family DNS. Your original network DNS settings are automatically preserved and restored when disabled.
settings.categoriesDesc: Manage how Tether classifies and groups applications on your device.
settings.appDirectoryDesc: Browse all detected applications on this PC and customize their categories.
settings.subtitle: How Tether tracks, protects and looks.
settings.themeDesc: Pick a color theme, or follow your system setting.

tutorial.title: How to Use
tutorial.subtitle: Shortcuts, hotkeys and app controls.
tutorial.step1: The Overview tab shows your daily screen time, broken down by category and application. Use the arrow buttons to browse previous days.
tutorial.step2: Go to the Limits tab to create daily time limits for specific apps or categories. When a limit is reached, the app will be blocked.
tutorial.step3: Set an Administrator PIN in Settings → Security to prevent limits from being easily removed.
tutorial.step4: Use the Web Filtering tab to block distracting websites. Add domains manually and they'll be enforced system-wide.
tutorial.step5: Toggle the HUD overlay in Settings to see remaining time directly on limited apps.
